nodes.label: Vercel Services backend routing
nodes.description: Public /_/backend paths select backend service before frontend catch-all; service rewrite strips prefix so Express receives /health and /api/users/me.

nodes.label: Express source entrypoint packaging
nodes.description: app.ts default-exports Express app; server.ts remains local listener; Vercel uses Express source entrypoint, ESM/NodeNext and Node 24 with development dependencies for typecheck.

nodes.label: Credential-free request logs
nodes.rationale: Log only request ID, method, path, status and media type; omit headers, query strings and bodies because Vercel injects credential-bearing headers.

nodes.label: Protected deployment verification
nodes.description: Verify health, unauthenticated JSON, deep links, real sign-in, memberships, project loading and runtime logs on exact preview commit; distinguish application 401 from Vercel protection.
